CustomObject.label: Picklist Translation
CustomObject.description: Guest-readable cache of Translation Workbench text for global value sets, keyed by value set + API value + language. Populated by Svc_PicklistTranslationSync.syncAll(), which reads the live Translation Workbench data via the Metadata API. Needed because the Experience Cloud site runs under a single fixed-language Guest User, so Apex picklist describe (which resolves translations from the running user's own language) cannot serve a per-visitor language on that site.
